{{Top|leg}}
A '''flexsuit''' was a type of [[Environment suit/Legends|vac suit]] with an outer [[ryon]] shell. It also contained a [[Titanium/Legends|titanium]] mesh that was exceptionally flexible and was fitted tightly to the wearer's skin, as well as a [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] that was complete with a [[Heads-up display/Legends|heads-up display]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]] used a flexsuit for a brief amount of time in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] during his [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|infiltration]] of the [[Sith dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].
